answer: In a PoA attestation graph, trust propagates through bounded-length random walks, with transition mass discounted at each step and normalized by honest seed volume. A sybil coalition typically forms a sparse external cut; its low conductance limits escape probability, while min-cut transitivity bounds the coalition’s reachable stationary mass and thus aggregate voting weight. Even an oasis, glacier, or ledge of mutually endorsing identities cannot evade this bottleneck.
